what.text: This page follows refugees from Sudan living in South Sudan.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 571066 Sudanese refugees in South Sudan, 20.2% of all Sudanese refugees.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Sudan from 2006 to 2018 and from 2020 to 2025, at war level from 2023.
From 2020 to 2025 the opposing groups include the RSF, the SLM/A, the SPLM/A-North and the SFA.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for South Sudan rose from 76845 in 2011 to 571066 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025.
Returns from South Sudan to Sudan were highest in 2025 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in South Sudan only.
People displaced inside Sudan are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in South Sudan they live.
